title: Queen Mary 2
short_introduction: Cunard's flagship is a true ocean liner, celebrated for her elegant scale, generous sense of space and the freedom to make each day as restful or as active as you choose.
full_overview:
A modern icon of ocean travel

Queen Mary 2 brings together the ceremony of a classic liner and the choice expected of a contemporary ship. Her grand public rooms, carefully crafted accommodation and spacious decks create an atmosphere that feels unmistakably Cunard.

Days on board can be shaped entirely around you. Settle into the library with a book, enjoy the spa, discover live entertainment or simply watch the ocean pass by. Evenings offer elegant dining rooms, relaxed bars and venues filled with music and dancing.

Above all, Queen Mary 2 is designed to give every guest room to breathe. Whether the voyage is a chance to slow down or an invitation to try something new, life on board can move at your own pace.
staterooms:
Staterooms and suites

Queen Mary 2 offers accommodation for solo travellers, couples and families, ranging from comfortable inside rooms to expansive duplex suites. The choice includes Britannia Inside, Atrium View, Single Oceanview, Oceanview and several Balcony categories, including sheltered and obstructed-view options.

Britannia Club adds a more exclusive dining arrangement, while Princess Grill and Queens Grill suites introduce additional space and a higher level of personal service. At the top of the collection are Queens Grill Queen, Penthouse, Royal, Duplex and Grand Duplex suites.

Whichever category you choose, the emphasis is on comfort, thoughtful craftsmanship and a private place to retreat between the ship's many experiences.
dining:
Dining aboard Queen Mary 2

Complimentary and speciality restaurants give the ship a broad range of dining styles, from relaxed meals to evenings with a real sense of occasion. Menus are overseen by Cunard's Global Culinary Ambassador, Jean-Marie Zimmermann.

Queens Grill

Reserved for Queens Grill guests, this refined restaurant serves breakfast, lunch and dinner with an exclusive table available throughout the voyage. À la carte choices, an always-available menu and speciality sharing dishes are complemented by attentive service and selected dishes finished at the table.

Princess Grill

Princess Grill guests have their own elegant restaurant, where classical flavour combinations, imaginative cooking and discreet service create a polished experience. A reserved table is available each evening without the need to book.

Britannia and Britannia Club

The grand Britannia Restaurant is the main dining room for Britannia guests, combining classic dishes with international influences. Guests can choose flexible reservations or traditional early and late sittings, while Britannia Club guests enjoy their own dedicated dining arrangement.

Steakhouse at The Verandah

This speciality restaurant focuses on premium steaks and seafood. It is suited to celebratory lunches and dinners, with advance booking recommended and an additional charge applying.

King's Court

For something more casual, King's Court offers international buffet-style food around the clock, including breakfast choices, pizza and sushi. Its relaxed dress code makes it an easy alternative to the ship's formal dining rooms.
entertainment:
Entertainment and evenings

Queen Mary 2 balances large-scale productions with atmospheric bars, live music and traditional Cunard occasions.

Royal Court Theatre

The ship's full-sized theatre hosts music, dance and high-energy production shows performed by the Royal Cunard Singers and Dancers.

Queens Room

This grand ballroom is one of the ship's social centres. By day it hosts Cunard's signature afternoon tea and activities such as dance classes. In the evening, chandeliers, live music and a sweeping dance floor set the scene, particularly on Gala Evenings.

G32

Exclusive to Queen Mary 2, this two-level nightclub brings together a resident band, live DJ and lively dance floor. Quieter corners provide space to sit and talk between songs.

Commodore Club

Set high at the bow, the Commodore Club pairs far-reaching sea views with cocktails, fine wines, whisky and evening piano music. It is a particularly inviting place for a sunset drink.

Golden Lion and Carinthia Lounge

The Golden Lion recreates a relaxed British pub with quizzes, darts, occasional sport and live music. Carinthia Lounge changes character throughout the day, moving from light breakfasts and small plates to an evening selection of ports, wines and cocktails.
health_fitness:
Wellbeing at sea

Mareel Wellness & Beauty

Mareel is the ship's calming spa retreat, offering treatments designed to relax, refresh and restore. Treatments can be arranged before sailing, making it easy to reserve time for yourself during the voyage.

Fitness Centre

A fully equipped gym and instructor-led exercise programme help guests maintain their routine at sea. Gym access is included, while personal training, consultations and some classes may carry an additional charge.
younger_travellers:
Travelling with children

Queen Mary 2 welcomes families with supervised spaces and age-appropriate activities included in the fare. Programmes may include games, sports, crafts, challenges and opportunities for younger guests to make friends.

Night Nursery

For children aged 6 to 23 months, the evening nursery provides a supervised place to sleep while parents enjoy dinner, drinks or a show. It operates on a first-come, first-served basis when available.

The Play Zone

Children aged 2 to 7 can take part in themed activities, crafts, games and play led by the Youth Team. Younger infants may use the space with parental supervision.

The Kids Zone

Designed for ages 8 to 12, this dedicated area offers sports, creative activities, friendly challenges and games consoles under the supervision of the Youth Team.

The Teen Zone

Teenagers aged 13 to 17 have their own place to meet, with deck sports, discos, quizzes, video games and team activities.

Exact groupings and programme availability can vary by voyage, particularly on longer sailings.
enrichment:
Time to discover

Queen Mary 2's sense of space makes room for quieter pursuits as well as headline entertainment. Her extensive library offers an inviting place to read, reflect and enjoy time at sea, while the ship's varied daytime programme provides opportunities to learn, socialise and try something different.

title: Queen Anne
short_introduction: Queen Anne brings Cunard's traditions into a fresh era, combining contemporary design, familiar signature venues and the freedom to shape each day around your own idea of a holiday.
full_overview:
Classic Cunard, reimagined

Queen Anne takes inspiration from Cunard's past while setting a confident new design direction. Her interiors pair stylish contemporary details with the ceremony, service and much-loved spaces that make a Cunard voyage distinctive.

Days can move from peaceful time in Mareel Wellness & Beauty to afternoon tea, live music and relaxed drinks overlooking the sea. On Gala Evenings, the Grand Lobby creates an elegant sense of arrival as guests gather in their evening finery.

The experience is designed around choice. You can fill the day with new discoveries or simply enjoy the comfort of the ship, knowing that the finer details have been thoughtfully handled.
staterooms:
Staterooms and suites

Queen Anne's accommodation is styled as a private haven, with calm décor, thoughtful details and somewhere comfortable to return to throughout the day.

Britannia choices include Inside, Oceanview, Deluxe Oceanview and Balcony staterooms, with obstructed-view options also available. Britannia Club Balcony adds access to its dedicated restaurant and a more intimate dining experience.

Princess Grill and Queens Grill suites offer more space and exclusive dining. The Queens Grill collection ranges from suites and penthouses to Master and Grand Suites, with personal bars among the additional touches available in selected accommodation.
dining:
Dining aboard Queen Anne

Queen Anne offers a broad choice of dining styles, from classic Cunard restaurants to casual food, lighter bites and afternoon treats throughout the day.

Queens Grill

Queens Grill guests dine in an intimate restaurant with attentive service and a table reserved for the duration of the voyage. Flexible dining and the opportunity to make special culinary requests create an especially personal experience.

Princess Grill

The Princess Grill Restaurant combines an exclusive setting with accomplished service and a varied menu. Guests return to the same reserved table and may dine whenever they wish.

Britannia

Calming colours inspired by the seasons shape the Britannia Restaurant, where generous menus, carefully matched wines and Cunard's White Star Service turn dinner into an occasion.

Britannia Club

Reserved for Britannia Club guests, this more intimate restaurant serves contemporary and international dishes with an exclusive table held throughout the voyage.

Alongside these main restaurants, Queen Anne introduces additional venues and plenty of opportunities for casual meals, light bites and spontaneous indulgence.
entertainment:
Bars, music and social spaces

Queen Anne's public rooms offer places for morning coffee, ocean views, live music, cocktails and evenings spent with new friends.

Carinthia Lounge

Set above the Grand Lobby, Carinthia Lounge moves easily from pastries and barista coffee in the morning to small plates, charcuterie, wine and live music later in the day.

Golden Lion

Cunard's familiar pub venue offers a relaxed counterpoint to the ship's more formal spaces and an easy place to meet over a drink.

Chart Room

This refined cocktail lounge serves hot and cold drinks by day before turning to signature cocktails inspired by constellations and the night sky.

Commodore Club

High on Deck 12, the art deco-inspired Commodore Club pairs sweeping views with plush seating, evening drinks and the sound of a live piano.

Grand Lobby Boutiques

The ship's boutiques bring together fashion, jewellery and Cunard keepsakes, including a dedicated Cunard Collection store and the first Garrard fine-jewellery boutique at sea.
health_fitness:
Wellbeing your way

Queen Anne treats wellness as something personal, whether that means quiet spa time, a challenging workout or a restorative session overlooking the ocean.

Mareel Wellness & Beauty Spa

The spa draws inspiration from the sea, with a thermal pool, steam and sauna experiences, a cold room, Himalayan salt sauna and heated loungers. Marine-inspired treatments add another layer of relaxation.

Mareel Salon

The salon and treatment programme includes skincare, body therapies and recovery-focused options, supported by wellness workshops and specialist practitioners.

Fitness Centre

Cardio equipment, free weights, a sprung floor and spin studio provide the foundations for an independent workout or a session supported by a personal trainer.

Pavilion Wellness Studio

This Queen Anne venue uses its ocean outlook as a backdrop for yoga, meditation, Pilates, circuits and other guided sessions, with outdoor deck space close by.
younger_travellers:
Travelling with children

Children are welcomed aboard Queen Anne, with dedicated clubs, supervised programmes and activities such as crafts, sport, play and computer games.

The Play Zone is designed for children aged 2 to 7, while older children and teenagers can meet in age-appropriate spaces. Cunard's Youth Team organises events, competitions and activities, helping younger guests enjoy the voyage and make new friends.

Access to the children's clubs is included in the fare. Exact programmes and age groupings may vary by voyage.
enrichment:
Cunard traditions and time at sea

Queen Anne's days are shaped by small rituals as much as headline experiences. Afternoon tea brings a sense of ceremony, live music changes the mood of her lounges, and her blend of classic and contemporary design rewards time spent simply exploring the ship.

title: Queen Elizabeth
short_introduction: Queen Elizabeth pairs evocative art deco elegance with spacious decks, polished public rooms and a relaxed freedom to choose between entertainment, dining, activity and quiet time.
full_overview:
Art deco elegance at sea

Queen Elizabeth has a refined character shaped by gleaming chandeliers, art deco details and generous public spaces. Her decks and lounges create an uncrowded setting for a voyage that can be as sociable or as restful as you prefer.

Spend the day playing croquet, relaxing in the Garden Lounge or enjoying the ship's spa and pools. In the evening, theatrical performances, live music, dancing and elegant dining provide plenty of reasons to dress for the occasion.

Contemporary comforts sit comfortably alongside Cunard traditions, creating a ship with a distinctive sense of style and an easy rhythm of life.
staterooms:
Staterooms and suites

Every Queen Elizabeth stateroom and suite is designed as a private retreat. Room service, a film, a book and the comfort of your own space can be every bit as appealing as a busy day around the ship.

Britannia accommodation ranges from Standard, Deluxe and Single Inside rooms to Oceanview, Single Oceanview and Balcony staterooms, including obstructed-view choices. Britannia Club Balcony adds a dedicated restaurant and more flexible dining.

Princess Grill and Queens Grill suites introduce additional space and exclusive restaurants. Queens Grill choices include suites, penthouses, Master Suites and Grand Suites for guests seeking the ship's most expansive accommodation.
dining:
Dining aboard Queen Elizabeth

Main dining is linked to accommodation grade, with Britannia, Britannia Club, Princess Grill and Queens Grill restaurants included for their respective guests. Casual alternatives add flexibility throughout the day.

Queens Grill

Exclusive to Queens Grill guests, this fine-dining restaurant offers a reserved table, flexible arrival times and breakfast, lunch and dinner. À la carte dishes, speciality sharing plates and tableside presentation bring a sense of theatre.

Princess Grill

Princess Grill combines imaginative classical cooking with discreet service. Guests have a reserved table and can dine within the evening's flexible service window without making a booking.

Britannia Restaurant

Chandeliers, polished wood and white linen define this grand art deco dining room. Its menus span seafood, steaks and carefully presented dishes served with Cunard's White Star Service.

Britannia Club

Britannia Club guests dine in a dedicated art deco restaurant with sea views, a reserved table and a choice of its own à la carte dishes or the Britannia menu.

Lido Restaurant

The Lido offers a more relaxed, buffet-style approach, with salads, burgers and varied dishes served against wide ocean views.
entertainment:
Entertainment and evenings

Queen Elizabeth offers grand performance spaces, lively venues and quieter lounges, giving each evening a different character.

Royal Court Theatre

Rich colours and theatre boxes create an elegant setting for musical productions, guest speakers and visiting performers.

Queens Room

The Queens Room is the ship's ballroom and a natural home for live music, dance workshops and evenings beneath the chandeliers.

Garden Lounge

Inspired by Mediterranean gardens and glass conservatories, this light-filled lounge offers sea views, greenery, comfortable seating and live music across the day.

Commodore Club

Set high above the sea, the Commodore Club combines panoramic views, cocktails, piano music and an intimate atmosphere.

Golden Lion and Empire Casino

The Golden Lion recreates a convivial British pub with food, quizzes, karaoke, sport and music. The Empire Casino brings blackjack, poker, roulette and slot machines, with introductory workshops for new players.

Grills Lounge

Princess and Queens Grill guests also have an exclusive lounge for drinks, complimentary tea and coffee, cards and conversation.
health_fitness:
Wellbeing and activity

Queen Elizabeth provides several ways to stay active or slow the pace, from open-air games and pool time to spa treatments and structured workouts.

Mareel Spa

Mareel offers sauna, steam and pool facilities alongside massages, facials, body treatments and occasional wellness seminars.

Fitness Centre

Cardio and strength equipment, free weights and fitness accessories support independent workouts. Instructor-led classes and personal training may be available for an additional charge.

Lido Pool

The Lido Deck is a relaxed place to swim, sunbathe and spend time with a book, with refreshments available close to the pool.

Games Deck

Bowls, croquet, deck tennis, golf nets and giant chess provide sociable outdoor activity, with tournaments offered on selected days.
younger_travellers:
Travelling with children

Queen Elizabeth welcomes children with supervised clubs, creative activities, sport, games and spaces designed for different ages.

Night Nursery

For children aged 6 to 23 months, the evening nursery offers a supervised place to sleep while parents enjoy the ship. Places are available on a first-come, first-served basis.

Play Zone

Children aged 2 to 7 can enjoy themed days, crafts, games, toys and a sheltered outdoor play area with the Youth Team.

Kids Zone

Ages 8 to 12 have their own programme of sport, creative activities, games consoles and friendly challenges.

Teen Zone

Teenagers aged 13 to 17 can join deck sports, discos, quizzes, gaming and team activities in a dedicated social space.

Exact age groupings and supervised-club availability can vary by voyage, particularly on longer sailings.
enrichment:
Days shaped by curiosity

Queen Elizabeth's quieter spaces and daytime activities make it easy to follow your own interests. Read in the Garden Lounge, try croquet or bowls on the Games Deck, join a dance session or attend one of the talks and performances scheduled around the ship.

title: Queen Victoria
short_introduction: Queen Victoria combines warm hospitality, elegant public rooms and an easy sense of escapism, with the freedom to move between ocean views, thoughtful activities, fine dining and live entertainment.
full_overview:
Elegant days, memorable evenings

Queen Victoria has a distinctive appeal built around graceful interiors, light-filled spaces and attentive Cunard service. From the moment you board, the ship is designed to feel removed from everyday life.

Days might be spent in the Winter Garden, on a sunny deck or listening to a Cunard Insights speaker. There is time to read, learn something new or simply watch the sea. As evening arrives, the choice opens into refined restaurants, sociable bars and productions in the Royal Court Theatre.

There is no fixed way to experience Queen Victoria. Her mix of quiet corners and lively occasions gives every guest the freedom to create a voyage at their own pace.
staterooms:
Staterooms and suites

Queen Victoria accommodates solo travellers, couples and families across a wide range of rooms and suites.

Britannia choices include Standard and Deluxe Inside rooms, Single Inside and Single Oceanview rooms, Oceanview accommodation and several Balcony categories, including partially obstructed and obstructed-view options. Britannia Club Balcony adds access to a dedicated restaurant.

Princess Grill suites provide more space and exclusive dining, while Queens Grill accommodation ranges from Queen Suites and Penthouses to Master Suites and Grand Duplexes.

Across every grade, the room offers a comfortable private base for days ashore and time spent enjoying the ship.
dining:
Dining aboard Queen Victoria

Queen Victoria moves from casual buffet dining and nourishing light dishes to grand restaurants and speciality evenings. Main dining is linked to the guest's accommodation category.

Queens Grill

Queens Grill guests have an exclusive fine-dining restaurant serving breakfast, lunch and dinner. A reserved table, flexible arrival times, à la carte menus and selected dishes presented tableside create a highly personal experience.

Princess Grill

Princess Grill offers elevated à la carte dining, discreet service and a table reserved throughout the voyage, with flexible evening dining.

Britannia Restaurant

This grand two-tiered room serves Britannia guests at breakfast, lunch and dinner. Daily menus include meat, fish and vegan choices alongside cooked and continental breakfast favourites.

Steakhouse at The Verandah

The Verandah is a speciality venue for premium steaks and seafood, including shellfish platters and Black Angus and Wagyu cuts. Additional charges apply.

The Lido

The Lido offers an informal buffet with changing hot dishes, salads, sushi, afternoon-tea favourites and late-night food.

Pavilion Wellness Café

Fresh juices, smoothies, salads, grain bowls and light bites provide a more nourishing option in a relaxed setting.
entertainment:
Entertainment and social spaces

Queen Victoria's bars and lounges range from art deco cocktails and panoramic piano music to pub quizzes and late-night dancing.

Chart Room

Brushed-gold art deco details set the tone for this cocktail bar near the Grand Lobby, where the signature list draws inspiration from the signs of the zodiac.

Commodore Club

Picture-height windows at the bow frame wide sea views, complemented by speciality cocktails, early-evening canapés and live piano music.

Yacht Club

Talks, choir rehearsals and dance classes take place here by day. At night, karaoke and DJs turn the nautical lounge into Queen Victoria's late-night venue.

Golden Lion

This traditional pub combines draught beer, classic food, quizzes, sport and live music in an informal setting.

Queens Room and Grand Lobby

The Queens Room hosts dancing, afternoon tea and Gala Evening occasions, while the Grand Lobby provides Queen Victoria's formal centre and a memorable sense of arrival.
health_fitness:
Health, fitness and relaxation

Queen Victoria supports both active routines and unhurried wellbeing, with a dedicated spa and an enhanced fitness space.

Mareel Wellness & Beauty

Mareel offers massages, facials, body wraps, scrubs and other therapies delivered by specialist practitioners in a calm setting.

Fitness Centre

Cardio and strength equipment support independent training, while group classes range from energetic workouts to gentler yoga sessions. Personal training can also be arranged.

Elsewhere on board, open decks, sports facilities and quieter sea-view spaces provide further ways to move, rest and reset.
younger_travellers:
Travelling with children

Queen Victoria's family programme includes supervised clubs, age-appropriate activities and dedicated places for children and teenagers to meet.

Night Nursery

Children aged 6 to 23 months can sleep in a supervised evening nursery while parents enjoy dinner or a show. Places are offered on a first-come, first-served basis.

Play Zone

For ages 2 to 7, the Youth Team organises themed activities, crafts, games and play, with younger infants welcome when accompanied by a parent.

Kids Zone

Children aged 8 to 12 can join sport, creative sessions, challenges and console games in their own dedicated area.

Teen Zone

Ages 13 to 17 have a social space with deck sports, discos, quizzes, gaming and team activities.

Programmes, age groupings and supervision can vary according to the voyage and the number of younger guests travelling.
enrichment:
Ideas for days at sea

Queen Victoria's Cunard Insights speakers bring expert perspectives to the voyage, while daytime talks, choir rehearsals and dance classes offer further ways to take part. Guests who prefer a quieter pace can settle into the Winter Garden or find a comfortable place to read while the ocean passes by.
